dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body mass from the wide mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and regular lateral margins where the skin meets the water, with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity median pixel value consistent with a mature white or very light-grey skin tone, uniform across the dorsal surface.
